Not reachable at runtime. Prototype pollution in mergeIncrementalResult. In src/ui the package is reached only through the @graphql-codegen/* dev tooling (npm ls @graphql-tools/utils), and nothing under src/ui/src imports @graphql-tools, so it never ships in the built bundle. The fixed releases depend on @whatwg-node/promise-helpers@2, which requires Node >=22.15.0, while the UI build pins Node 22.14.0 (.gitlab-ci.yml, the UI CodeBuild project in template.yaml, scripts/sdlc/cfn/codepipeline-s3.yml) and src/ui/.npmrc sets engine-strict=true, so the bump fails npm ci. Revisit when the Node pin moves to 22.15 or later.

Not reachable. Per-request WebSocket connection parameters persisting into later authentications in the legacy WebSocket executor. In src/ui the package is reached only through @graphql-codegen/cli -> @graphql-tools/url-loader (npm ls @graphql-tools/executor-legacy-ws), dev tooling that never ships in the built bundle; nothing under src/ui/src imports @graphql-tools, and codegen.config.mjs loads the schema from the local nested/api-resolvers/src/api/schema.graphql file, so no WebSocket executor is ever constructed. The fix (1.1.36) requires @graphql-tools/utils ^12.0.2, which is blocked by the Node 22.14.0 pin for the same reason as GHSA-c4qx-w738-7hr3. Revisit when the Node pin moves to 22.15 or later.

Not reachable. The advisory is in the SDK's Agent2Agent (A2A) server (strands.multiagent.a2a), which shares conversation history across callers. This repo never starts an A2A server: nothing imports strands.multiagent.a2a or A2AServer, and the a2a extra is not installed anywhere; every agent here runs in-process inside a Lambda invocation for one caller. The fix (1.43.0) is 29 minor versions past the 1.14.0 pin across idp_common's agent, extraction and discovery extras and nested/multi-doc-discovery, which needs its own upgrade change. Re-check this entry if an A2A server is ever added.

Not reachable. The advisory is in FileSessionManager (strands.session.file_session_manager), whose default storage under /tmp/strands/sessions follows a pre-placed symlink when it writes session files. The SDK creates no session manager on its own: Agent's session_manager argument defaults to None in 1.14.0, and FileSessionManager is instantiated only by the caller. Nothing in this repo imports strands.session, names FileSessionManager or any SessionManager, or passes session_manager to an Agent (git grep over every tracked file, including idp_common/agents, extraction/agentic_idp.py, the discovery code and nested/multi-doc-discovery); chat history is persisted to DynamoDB by src/lambda/agent_chat_processor, not through strands. The fix (1.48.0) is 34 minor versions past the 1.14.0 pin and belongs with the same agent-framework upgrade as GHSA-4v6f-7vjh-6x4m. Re-check this entry if a strands session manager is ever configured.
